text: Hamza delivered an outstanding ticket triage system that cut our first‑response time by 41% and routed nearly 80% of tickets automatically. The impact on our support efficiency was immediate and measurable.
The RAG assistant over 4,000 policy PDFs performed flawlessly, answering 85% of the test questions with proper citations. This has dramatically improved our compliance review process.
Defect detection on the bottling line achieved 96% recall at 30 fps on an edge GPU, keeping our quality standards high without slowing production.
Demand forecasting now has a MAPE of 11% versus 19% before, giving us better inventory decisions and reducing stockouts.
The fine‑tuned sentiment model for Urdu‑English reviews reached an F1 of 0.88, a huge jump from the 0.71 of the off‑the‑shelf model, and it’s already boosting our marketing insights.
Lead‑scoring improved conversion by 3.2x for top‑decile leads, giving our sales team a clear focus and higher win rates.
The model‑serving API delivers real‑time predictions with 120 ms p95 latency at 50 requests/s, keeping our fintech platform responsive and reliable.
The resume parser cut recruiters’ shortlist time from 2 hours to just 15 minutes per role, freeing up talent acquisition for higher‑value tasks.
Price‑monitoring tracked 12,000 SKUs daily and flagged anomalies within an hour, helping us maintain competitive pricing and avoid costly errors.
Customer churn prediction achieved an AUC of 0.84, and our retention campaign cut churn by 9% in the target group, proving the model’s business value.
Handwritten form digitisation achieved 94% character accuracy, eliminating 3 full‑time data entry staff and speeding up patient record processing.
The LLM evaluation harness caught three regressions before release, reducing our launch risk and cutting evaluation time from 40 minutes to just six.
Recommendation engine increased click‑through by 22%, directly boosting sales and customer engagement on our online bookstore.
Speech‑to‑text pipeline transcribed 5,000 calls per day, raising QA coverage from 2% to 100% and giving us full visibility into customer interactions.
Document Q&A chatbot cut routine research time by about 30%, allowing associates to focus on more complex legal work.
Fraud‑detection features reduced chargebacks by 18% while keeping false positives under 1%, protecting revenue and customer trust.
Named‑entity extraction from shipping invoices achieved 0.93 F1, slashing manual keying effort by 70% and speeding up logistics processing.
